selection_basis: Independent overfitting review; narrow lattice shortcut and radius sampler excluded regardless of final score
remaining_conditions_before_deployment: Sync declared pinned dependencies and verify main source matches candidate
selection.holdout_policy: This candidate is selected before observing either holdout result. No problem-specific features, heuristic parameter changes or reactivation of excluded experiments in response to holdout/final results. Report limitations.
selection.raw_scoring: Keep all reference mismatches in exact-set counts, including the separately witnessed JMO-2014-PRE-09 DSL/reference discrepancy; do not change solver outputs or reference answers to improve scores.

evaluation_contract.metric: exact canonical descriptor-set equality, including missing and extra answers
evaluation_contract.timing: outer process wall time, including failures and startup

material_slowdown_evidence.interpretation: Largest observed slowdown is concentrated in refinement and recurs on all three final seeds. It is a remaining regression, not dismissed as measurement noise. No case-specific rescue or post-holdout source change was made. The causal contribution of individual accepted changes is not isolated by this final comparison.

paired_seed0.interpretation: Single same-seed paired observation per case; small differences can be timing noise. Repeatedly used development corpus, not a generalization estimate.

holdout.limits: Six generated structural families with dependent variants; not 48 independent geometries or an estimate for arbitrary unseen tasks. Frozen before first solve; no post-holdout tuning.

reference_discrepancy.interpretation: Current endpoint-inclusive DSL admits answer 5 in addition to 60/23; all raw mismatches remain in the reported score.

limitations: No proof of global optimality or complete solution enumeration.
Multiple candidates used the public development set; its final score is not unseen accuracy.
Dependency change to gmpy2 is intentional; other solver runtime dependency versions stayed fixed.
Measurements share a host with other work; per-job CPU affinity is recorded but wall times are not noise-free.
Linux verified; Windows/macOS not physically tested. Optional CPU-budget algebraic paths decline where the required timer is unavailable.
Dormant lattice and radius-sampler experiment modules remain in the source tree but are excluded from production invocation by regression-tested policy.
